# attends to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attendsTo`](gmeow-attendsTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attendsTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Directed attention or salience of an agent toward a subject — what the agent is currently focused on. NOT a goal: an attentional pull, not a teleology:Desire — the axes stay orthogonal and are never bridged by axiom ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Whose attention it is rides [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement (self-attributed vs observer-attributed coexist).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attendsTo`](gmeow-attendsTo.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record what an agent is currently focused on — directed attention or salience toward a subject, the recall/salience surface the agent-memory flagship reads ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a wanted goal or intention (that is the teleology slice — attention is an attentional pull, not a conative mode, and the axes are never bridged by axiom, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid it for sustained motivational orientation (use [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:attendsTo`](gmeow-attendsTo.md) from agent to subject; carry whose-attention and when on the statement layer via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) (self- vs observer-attributed coexist), and keep it distinct from teleology goals by review, not axiom.

### Scope notes

- Boundary: attention/interest (cognition) ⊥ intention (teleology). [`attendsTo`](gmeow-attendsTo.md) / [`interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md) / [`curiousAbout`](gmeow-curiousAbout.md) are attentional-affective pulls toward a subject; a teleology:Desire/Intention is a goal-directed conative mode aimed at a state of affairs. No [owl:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#subPropertyOf) or [owl:disjointWith](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#disjointWith) ties them — the separation is conceptual, enforced by review ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
